trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is no separate task. PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and about 200 hours, with the 100% Completion checklist the long pole. Keep cheats off for the whole run: they disable trophies and saving.
steps: Finish the five story chapters
Work the 100% Completion checklist after the credits
Clean up Strangers & Freaks and the Chapter 1 meditation
Keep cheats off the entire playthrough

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: Opening mission — GTA VI has no mission replay, so it only comes around once per save.
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It is the first mission you play, and because GTA VI has no mission replay it only happens once — just play it when it appears and the trophy pops at the end.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening
Follow the prompts through Gone Fishing
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The story runs five chapters and takes roughly 60–80 hours (PowerPyx); chapter trophies pop as you complete each chapter, so keep playing the story and they come on their own.
steps: Play through Chapter 1's missions
The trophy pops when the chapter ends

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Chapter trophies are story progression — you cannot miss them by playing normally, because you have to finish the chapter to reach the next one.
steps: Play through Chapter 2's missions
The trophy pops when the chapter ends

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Same as the other chapter trophies: complete the chapter's missions in order and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end.
steps: Play through Chapter 3's missions
The trophy pops when the chapter ends

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The penultimate chapter — complete its missions and the trophy pops at the chapter's end, leaving only the final chapter.
steps: Play through Chapter 4's missions
The trophy pops when the chapter ends

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission — the end of Chapter 5 and the story. After the credits the game returns you to free-roam, so anything you have not finished stays available for cleanup.
steps: Finish Chapters 1–4
Play the final mission through to the credits
Free-roam continues afterwards for cleanup

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run. Story missions pop on completion, and you must finish them to advance the story, so play the mission when its marker appears.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story
Complete the mission
The trophy pops on completion

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A story heist mission — play it when its marker appears and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story
Complete the mission
The trophy pops on completion

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. A story mission — it unlocks by finishing the mission, which you have to do to keep the story moving.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story
Complete the mission
The trophy pops on completion

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. A story mission — finish it when its marker appears and the trophy pops at the end.
steps: Reach Headliners in the story
Complete the mission
The trophy pops on completion

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport — finish it when its marker appears and the trophy unlocks on completion.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story
Complete the mission
The trophy pops on completion

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A story mission — play it through when its marker appears and the trophy pops at the end.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story
Complete the mission
The trophy pops on completion

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion — the hardest trophy in the set, and the longest grind. The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, but progress you make during the story already counts. PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% true completion: you need 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, and 70 of 80 challenges. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything.
steps: Finish the story first — the checklist unlocks after the credits
Scan vehicles (200 of 277) and study animals (100 of 255) as you play
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges
Finish every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — stunt jumps and unique stunts across Leonida. Stunts are the jumps, ramps and airtime moments the game tracks; work them into your driving between missions rather than hunting all 250 at once.
steps: Watch for stunt jumps and ramps while driving
Land jumps cleanly — the game counts completed stunts
Keep a running total in Progress > Stats
Mop up the last few in free-roam after the story

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are nine activity types on the map — play one round of each and the trophy pops. Use the map to find an activity you have not tried yet and start it.
steps: Open the map and look for activity icons
Play one round of each of the nine activity types
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 shooting-range gold medals to earn (per the published guides), at the ranges around Leonida — usually at Ammu-Nation. Gold needs accuracy and speed, so learn each range's layout, then run it clean.
steps: Find a shooting range and open its challenges
Earn gold on every challenge — 42 gold medals in total
Replay a challenge as often as needed; gold is per challenge, not per run

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone race locations with 42 races between them (PowerPyx). Win at least one race at each of the 14 spots — you do not need to win all 42.
steps: Find the drone race locations on the map
Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations
Learn each course's line before racing it for the win

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races count per event, so winning the same race twice does not help — work through 20 distinct race events across Leonida.
steps: Find race events on the map
Win 20 different races — repeats do not count
Try different vehicle classes to find your strongest

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head contests — out-fish Cal to take the win. Use the best rod and bait you can get before challenging him.
steps: Find a fishing challenge and meet Cal
Out-fish Cal in the challenge
Upgrade your rod and bait first if you keep losing

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, start a game and play it to its end. Any arcade game counts — pick the one you are best at.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet
Start any arcade game
Play it through to completion

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Strand finale — finish Andy's strand before the story moves past it; there is no mission replay.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's missions are a side strand — take each one as it appears and finish the strand's final mission. Side strands can lock out as the story advances, so do not leave Andy's missions sitting.
steps: Take Andy's missions as they appear
Work through the strand to its final mission
Complete the final mission

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Strand finale — finish Kenton's strand before the story moves past it; there is no mission replay.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is a side storyline — play its missions as they appear and finish with the final mission. Clear side strands as they open rather than saving them all for after the story.
steps: Take Kenton's missions as they appear
Work through the strand to its final mission
Complete the final mission

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Strand finale — finish Billy's strand before the story moves past it; there is no mission replay.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is a side storyline — take its missions when they appear and finish the strand's final mission.
steps: Take Billy's missions as they appear
Work through the strand to its final mission
Complete the final mission

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Eight strands — skipping one entirely can lock the trophy; take stranger missions as they appear.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers & Freaks strands appear as icons on the map — take each one as it appears and finish all eight strands. Do the stranger missions during the story, not after, because strands can lock out as the story advances.
steps: Watch for stranger icons on the map
Start each of the 8 strands
Complete all 8 strands to the end

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: Strand finale — finish Randy's strand before the story moves past it; there is no mission replay.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a side storyline — play its missions as they appear and finish with the final mission.
steps: Take Randy's missions as they appear
Work through the strand to its final mission
Complete the final mission

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: Strand finale — finish Tyrone's strand before the story moves past it; there is no mission replay.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is a side storyline — take its missions when they appear and finish the strand's final mission.
steps: Take Tyrone's missions as they appear
Work through the strand to its final mission
Complete the final mission

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: CONFIRMED potentially missable (PowerPyx): the first meditation, at Jason's house, is only offered in Chapter 1. Do it before leaving Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, as Jason and Lucia. This is the one trophy the published guides flag as potentially missable: the first meditation is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes unavailable after that chapter, so meditate there before moving on. After that, work through the remaining spots whenever they appear.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at Jason's house before leaving the chapter
Meditate at each spot as you find it — 18 spots, 10 locations
The trophy pops at the last spot

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are hunting jobs — track down the unique animal he asks for and take it down. Bret's quests are also part of the 100% checklist, which needs all of them, so do them properly.
steps: Take Bret's quests as they appear
Track the unique animal he names
Hunt it and return to Bret

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida in sets — collect every card in three full sets. Use the map and your collection log to see which sets are still missing cards.
steps: Find collectible cards around Leonida
Complete all cards in a set
Finish 3 full sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are photo or check-in points scattered across the state — visit 100 of them and trigger the WAiNK action at each. They are marked as you explore, so fold them into your driving routes.
steps: Look for WAiNK spots while exploring
Trigger WAiNK at each spot you find
Reach 100 locations

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in the game and you only need 50 of them for this trophy — and 70 of 80 for 100% completion — so skip the hardest ones and clear the ones that suit you.
steps: Open the challenges list
Complete any 50 challenges
Skip the hardest ones — you only need 50 of 80

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the police to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. Use alleys, the countryside or water to break the search.
steps: Bring your partner along
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars
Break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner, keeping a wanted level the whole time — plan a route between three close shops and move fast between them.
steps: Bring your partner and pick three close shops
Rob the first shop to raise your wanted level
Hit the next two back-to-back without losing the wanted level

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game counts a vehicle as discovered when you get in or scan it — drive everything you see, and scan new models with the camera. You need 200 of 277 scanned for 100% completion, so this trophy comes on the way.
steps: Drive and scan new vehicles as you see them
Check your vehicle log for what is missing
Reach 100 discovered

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-time aiming mode — trigger it in a fight with at least five enemies close together and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy firefight and line the shots up.
steps: Get into a fight with 5 or more enemies close together
Trigger Combat Focus
Take down all 5 before it ends

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: One-time event — the unscheduled departure at VCIA happens once; do it when the chance appears.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This is a one-time moment at Vice City International Airport — when the chance to leave by air outside the schedule comes up, take it. There is no mission replay, so do it when it appears rather than saving it for later.
steps: Head to VCIA when the opportunity appears
Take the unscheduled departure
The trophy pops on departure

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank and stir up trouble — the trophy is about driving the tank and using it, so take it for a spin through the city.
steps: Find a Rhino tank
Drive it and use it in the open
The trophy pops once you have had your fun in it

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: One-time moment — rob the jewelry store clean without being detected; a botched attempt can spoil the run.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan it like a quiet job: go in, take the goods and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the run is blown — leave, lose the heat and try the store again with a cleaner approach.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and case it first
Rob it without being detected
Get clear before the alarm goes up

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are the big robbery jobs — crack five of them and get away clean each time. Plan your escape route before you go in.
steps: Find a bank vault job
Rob the vault
Escape clean — repeat for 5 vaults

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida — stop one, take its cash and get away before the police close in.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route
Stop it and take the cash
Escape before the police catch you

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named area of the state — the trophy tracks map coverage, so drive, fly and walk into the corners you have not seen yet. The map shows what is still unexplored.
steps: Open the map and look for unexplored areas
Visit every region of Leonida
The trophy pops when the map is fully explored

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations — hit one operation per gang. Learn which gang holds which spot, then work through the list.
steps: Learn which gang runs each illegal operation
Rob one operation per gang
The trophy pops when every gang has been hit

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. A quiet story moment — it comes to you by playing, so stop at the beach when you are nearby.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach
Order a cocktail with the view
The trophy pops as you enjoy it

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: One-time scripted moment — the showroom smash happens once; do it when the scene plays.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This is a scripted story beat — when the showroom scene plays, drive straight through it the way the scene asks. There is no mission replay, so take the moment when it comes.
steps: Reach the showroom scene in the story
Smash your way out as the scene directs
The trophy pops on the way out

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish a game with a proper follow-through. Any completed game at that alley counts.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Play a full game of bowling
Finish with a follow-through

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one comes from playing the story with your partner — it is a vague story moment the published guides have not pinned down yet, so it will pop by playing the campaign rather than by hunting for it.
steps: Play through the story with your partner
It unlocks during the campaign — no separate task

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Choice moment — the published guides have not pinned down the exact trigger; pick deliberately when a story choice appears.
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). A story moment tied to a decision you make — the published guides have not pinned down the exact trigger yet, so it comes from playing the story and choosing deliberately when a choice appears.
steps: Play through the story
Make the story choices when they appear
The trophy pops on the choice it is tied to

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Choice moment — 'second time's the charm' points to a decision you get one more shot at; choose carefully.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. A story moment about a second chance — the published guides have not pinned down the exact trigger yet, so it comes from playing the story. When a choice you already faced comes around again, take it.
steps: Play through the story
Watch for a choice that comes around a second time
Take it when it appears

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: One-time story event — the published guides have not pinned down the exact trigger; it comes from a single story beat.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A single story beat — the published guides have not pinned down the exact trigger yet, and the name is deliberately vague. It comes from playing the story; you will know it when it happens.
steps: Play through the story
It unlocks at its story beat — no separate task

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. At the bowling alley, take out the pins with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by, on foot is not enough. Line the car up with the pins and swing as you pass.
steps: Go to a bowling alley with a vehicle
Line up a melee drive-by on the pins
Bowl them over in one pass

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — hand them to your contacts to wash them into clean cash. It adds up across the whole game, so keep laundering as you earn.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies
Launder them through your contacts
Reach $250,000 laundered in total

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Money spent anywhere counts — weapons, clothes, food, car mods. It adds up across the whole game, so just play and spend normally and it will come.
steps: Spend money at any shops
Weapons, clothes and car mods all count
Reach $100,000 spent in total

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages go on sale around Leonida — buy every one. They are also useful for storing the vehicles you collect, so buy them as you find them.
steps: Find garage properties for sale
Buy each one
The trophy pops when the last garage is yours

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles you own — register ten of them. Any ten vehicles count, so use the ones you drive most.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app
Register a vehicle you own
Register 10 vehicles in total
